uncited: This family uses deep neural networks to reconstruct high-resolution volumetric data or isosurface renderings from low-resolution inputs, addressing the loss of detail and artifacts inherent in traditional interpolation.

It distinguishes itself from sibling methods by leveraging learned spatial priors and non-linear mappings rather than fixed mathematical kernels, enabling significant upscaling factors and artifact suppression that simple upsampling cannot achieve.
